kept.excerpt: As of early July 2026, Claude Fable 5 was described as the highest-rated model overall, with an approximately 1509 Arena score. Claude Opus 4.6–4.8 Thinking variants were described as extremely close behind Fable 5.
kept.relevance: Provides a contemporaneous indication of proximity to 1510, although the article does not identify the style-control setting and therefore cannot establish the resolution-specific score.

kept.excerpt: The July 10, 2026 changelog entry states that muse-spark-1.1 was added to the Text Arena and Code Arena leaderboards. The July 2 entry states that claude-sonnet-5-thinking was added to Code Arena, Text Arena, Search Arena, Vision Arena, and Document Arena leaderboards.
kept.relevance: Documents recent additions to the qualifying Text Arena leaderboard before the experiment cutoff, showing that the evaluated model pool was continuing to expand.

kept.excerpt: As of June 30, the export controls on Fable 5 and Mythos 5 had been lifted. Anthropic said Fable 5 would be available globally starting July 1 on the Claude Platform, Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. A July 1 update states that access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 was restored.
kept.relevance: Establishes that the model reported near the threshold had returned to public availability before the cutoff following an interruption in deployment.

kept.excerpt: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 on June 9, describing it as a Mythos-class model made safe for general use. Anthropic stated that its capabilities exceeded those of any model the company had previously made generally available and that it was state-of-the-art on nearly all tested AI capability benchmarks.
kept.relevance: Provides dated primary-source evidence of a new frontier model release, while the performance statements remain vendor claims rather than qualifying Arena scores.

kept.excerpt: GPT-5.6 is a new family of three models: Sol, OpenAI's new flagship model; Terra, a capable lower-cost option; and Luna, its fastest and most cost-efficient model. OpenAI published the family’s system card on July 9, 2026.
kept.relevance: Identifies a newly released competing frontier model family immediately before the cutoff, without assuming that its general capabilities translate into a particular Arena score.

kept.excerpt: Arena released the full history of its published leaderboards as a public-access dataset. The release covered 14 subsets across 10 arenas, including separate variants with and without style control, and included a leaderboard publication date for each entry. Arena reported that the mean score of the leading Text Arena models had risen from a little over 1,000 in May 2023 to nearly 1,500.
kept.relevance: Supplies official historical progression context and establishes the dated, non-style-controlled dataset needed to reconstruct the exact baseline relevant to the threshold.

kept.excerpt: Arena published Arena-Rank, an open-source Python package that powers its leaderboard. Its example fits a Bradley–Terry ranking model and prints ratings and confidence intervals. Arena said the implementation used closed-form confidence intervals instead of bootstrap intervals.
kept.relevance: Explains the statistical mechanism behind the score, helping distinguish a published point estimate crossing 1510 from uncertainty intervals or ordinal rankings.

search_notes: Frozen evidence cutoff: 2026-07-13, inclusive. Only explicitly dated publications or individually dated changelog entries on or before that date are included; no prediction-market material, odds, or later developments are included. Publication dates and excerpts were checked against web_search-indexed source text. web_fetch failed because its provider configuration was ambiguous; the requested agent-reach fallback returned a rate-limit error, so full-page fallback verification was unavailable. The ReadyTools score is approximate and its style-control setting is unspecified. A verified July 13 Text Arena Overall snapshot with style control off was not obtained; this pack therefore does not establish the exact cutoff-day qualifying leader score. For sources with updates, only content dated on or before the cutoff was used: Anthropic's July 1 restoration update and Arena-Rank's stated February 21, 2026 update are within the permitted window.
